text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 10, 2026) for 79 Osborne Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order, (March 10, 2026), for 79 Osborne Avenue, Folder No. 26 116574 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 31, 2026.
